section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

end Formula.subformulae


class Formulae.SubformulaClosed (X : Formulae α) where
  imp_closed : ∀ {φ ψ}, φ ➝ ψ ∈ X → φ ∈ X ∧ ψ ∈ X
  box_closed : ∀ {φ}, □φ ∈ X → φ ∈ X

namespace SubformulaClosed

instance [DecidableEq α] {φ : Formula α} : Formulae.SubformulaClosed (φ.subformulae) where
  imp_closed hpq := ⟨Formula.subformulae.mem_imp₁ hpq, Formula.subformulae.mem_imp₂ hpq⟩
  box_closed hp := Formula.subformulae.mem_box hp


variable {φ : Formula α} {X : Formulae α} [closed : X.SubformulaClosed]

lemma mem_box (h : □φ ∈ X) : φ ∈ X := closed.box_closed h
macro_rules | `(tactic| trivial) => `(tactic| apply mem_box $ by assumption)

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

<STATEMENT>
The negation of a formula after substituting a term is equivalent to the substitution of the term into the negation of the formula.
</STATEMENT>

<PROOF>
The statement expresses a fundamental property of logical formulas and substitution. Specifically, it asserts that substituting a term into a negated formula is logically equivalent to negating the result of the substitution in the original formula. This can be seen as a consequence of the fact that substitution preserves logical equivalence and that negation is a structural operation that can be moved across the substitution without affecting its truth value. Formally, for any propositional formula φ and term substitution σ, the formula obtained by substituting σ in the negation of φ is the same as the negation of the formula obtained by substituting σ in φ. This property is important in maintaining consistency and correctness in logical manipulations and substitutions.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)

informal_statement: Substituting a term into both sides of an implication does not change the implication's meaning or truth value; that is, substituting a term into the entire implication φ → ψ is equivalent to separately substituting the same term into φ and ψ.
informal_proof: Firstly, we take an arbitrary implication φ → ψ. When we substitute a term σ into both φ and ψ, we obtain φ[σ] → ψ[σ]. On the other hand, substituting σ into each side separately also yields φ[σ] → ψ[σ], which matches the substituted implication. Therefore, substitution within an implication maintains its structure and meaning.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

  | box _ => true
  | _  => false

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

  | atom a, ψ => by

    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

instance : ModalDeMorgan (Formula α) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]
  neg := by simp
  dia := by simp
  box := by simp

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

informal_statement: For any atom `a` and substitution `σ`, substituting `a` with `σ` in the atomic context yields `σ a`. In other words, when an atom is substituted within its own context, the result is simply the substitution applied to the atom itself.
informal_proof:
To understand why this statement holds, we need to consider the nature of substitution and the context in which atoms are present. In the given scenario, `atom a` represents an atomic expression involving the variable `a`. When we apply a substitution `σ` to `atom a`, we are essentially replacing `a` with `σ` within the bounds of the atom's context.

In Lean4, this substitution is handled by the `simp` tactic, which simplifies expressions based on definitions. Here, since `atom a` is being substituted for `a`, and the substitution `σ` is designed to replace `a` with `σ a`, the two expressions are definitionally equal. This equality arises because both sides of the equation directly represent the substitution of `a` with `σ a` in their respective contexts.

Therefore, the statement `(atom a).subst σ = σ a` is trivially true by the nature of substitution as implemented in the `simp` tactic, making this lemma a suitable candidate for simplification in Lean4.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

/-
instance : ModalDeMorgan (Formula α) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]
  neg := by simp
  dia := by simp
  box := by simp
-/

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

informal_statement: Substitution preserves equivalence in a modal logic system. Specifically, for any substitution `σ` and any formula `φ`, the substituted formula `φ.subst σ` is equivalent to `φ` in the modal logic system.
informal_proof:
We will prove this by induction on the structure of the formula `φ`.

**Base Case:**  
If `φ` is an atomic formula (`atom a`), then `φ.subst σ` directly substitutes `a` with `σ a`. Therefore, `φ.subst σ` is equivalent to `φ` because substitution at the atomic level is straightforward and preserves the formula's meaning.

**Inductive Step:**  
Assume the lemma holds for all formulas of complexity less than `φ`. We consider the cases based on the structure of `φ`.

1. **Negation (`¬φ`):**  
   By inductive hypothesis, `φ.subst σ` is equivalent to `φ`, so `(¬φ).subst σ` becomes `¬(φ.subst σ)`, which is equivalent to `¬φ` and thus to `(¬φ).subst σ`.

2. **Implication (`φ → ψ`):**  
   Again, by inductive hypothesis, both `φ.subst σ` and `ψ.subst σ` are equivalent to `φ` and `ψ` respectively. Therefore, `(φ → ψ).subst σ` becomes `φ.subst σ → ψ.subst σ`, which preserves the equivalence as `φ → ψ`.

3. **Modal Operator (`□φ`):**  
   For the modal operator, `φ.subst σ` becomes `□(φ.subst σ)`. Since `φ.subst σ` is equivalent to `φ` by inductive hypothesis, `□(φ.subst σ)` becomes `□φ`, maintaining the equivalence.

Thus, by induction, substitution preserves equivalence for all well-formed formulas in the modal logic system. This completes the proof of the substitution lemma.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

/-
instance : ModalDeMorgan (Formula α) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]
  neg := by simp
  dia := by simp
  box := by simp
-/

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

  box_closed : ∀ {φ}, □φ ∈ X → φ ∈ X

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

informal_statement: The function `ofNat_toNat` ensures that converting a formula from `Formula α` to `Nat formula` and back to `Formula α` results in the original formula.
informal_proof:
To prove that `ofNat (toNat φ) = φ` for any formula `φ`, we consider different cases based on the structure of `φ`:

1. **Atomic Propositions (`atom a`):** If `φ` is an atomic proposition, both `toNat` and `ofNat` operations will retain the atomic nature without altering the content or meaning. Thus, `ofNat (toNat φ)` results in the same atomic proposition `φ`.

2. **Bottom Formula (`⊥`):** The bottom formula represents a contradiction or an always false statement. Both `toNat` and `ofNat` leave it unchanged, so `ofNat (toNat ⊥)` is still `⊥`.

3. **Box Operator (`□φ`):** The box operator typically denotes necessity or universal closure in certain logics. The `toNat` function converts `□φ` into its natural counterpart, and `ofNat` reverts it back without loss of meaning, preserving `□φ` when converted back.

4. **Implication (`φ ➝ ψ`):** Logical implications maintain their structure through the `toNat` and `ofNat` conversions. Thus, applying these functions in sequence preserves the implication's original form, resulting in `φ ➝ ψ`.

By verifying these cases, we ensure that the composition of `toNat` and `ofNat` operations is an identity function over formulas, satisfying `ofNat (toNat φ) = φ`.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

  box_closed : ∀ {φ}, □φ ∈ X → φ ∈ X

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

  | atom a, ψ => by

          (this _ hf).comp₁ (fun m => Encodable.encode <| (@decode (List.Vector ℕ n) _ m).map f)
            Primrec'.encode).of_eq
      fun i => by simp [encodek]
  fun f hf => by
  induction hf with
  | zero => exact const 0
  | succ => exact succ
  | left => exact unpair₁ head
  | right => exact unpair₂ head
  | pair _ _ hf hg => exact natPair.comp₂ _ hf hg
  | comp _ _ hf hg => exact hf.comp₁ _ hg
  | prec _ _ hf hg =>
    simpa using
      prec' (unpair₂ head) (hf.comp₁ _ (unpair₁ head))
        (hg.comp₁ _ <|
          natPair.comp₂ _ (unpair₁ <| tail <| tail head) (natPair.comp₂ _ head (tail head)))

informal_statement: The function `ofNat` maps each natural number to a formula in the following way: 0 maps to no formula, 1 maps to an atomic formula, 2 maps to a boxed atomic formula, 3 maps to an implication between two formulas, and any natural number greater than or equal to 4 maps to no formula.
informal_proof:
The function `ofNat` is defined to handle natural numbers as follows:

- For the natural number 0, the function returns `none`, indicating no formula is assigned to it.
- For the natural number 1, which corresponds to a pair with index 0 and constant, the function returns the decoded formula as an atomic formula.
- For the natural number 2, which corresponds to a pair with index 0 or 1, the function returns a boxed formula, indicating that the decoded inner formula is necessarily true.
- For the natural number 3, which corresponds to a pair with index 1 or 2, the function returns an implication formula between the two decoded formulas, representing a conditional relationship.
- For any natural number greater than or equal to 4, the function returns `none`, meaning no formula is assigned to such numbers.

This completes the informal accounting of the `ofNat` function's behavior as described in its formal definition.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

/-
instance : ModalDeMorgan (Formula α) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]
  neg := by simp
  dia := by simp
  box := by simp
-/

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

  | atom a, ψ => by

rag.name: Nat.Primrec'.of_prim
rag.content:
theorem of_prim {n f} : Primrec f → @Primrec' n f :=
  suffices ∀ f, Nat.Primrec f → @Primrec' 1 fun v => f v.head from fun hf =>
    (pred.comp₁ _ <|
          (this _ hf).comp₁ (fun m => Encodable.encode <| (@decode (List.Vector ℕ n) _ m).map f)
            Primrec'.encode).of_eq
      fun i => by simp [encodek]
  fun f hf => by
  induction hf with
  | zero => exact const 0
  | succ => exact succ
  | left => exact unpair₁ head
  | right => exact unpair₂ head
  | pair _ _ hf hg => exact natPair.comp₂ _ hf hg
  | comp _ _ hf hg => exact hf.comp₁ _ hg
  | prec _ _ hf hg =>
    simpa using
      prec' (unpair₂ head) (hf.comp₁ _ (unpair₁ head))
        (hg.comp₁ _ <|
          natPair.comp₂ _ (unpair₁ <| tail <| tail head) (natPair.comp₂ _ head (tail head)))

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]

  dia := by simp
  box := by simp
