/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁ | h₂;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.complexity];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;
  | hatom => simp_all [subformulae];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

/-
@[simp]
lemma degree_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.degree ≤ φ.degree := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp φ₁ φ₂ ihp₁ ihp₂ =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | h₁ | h₂;
    . simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp₁ h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
    . have := ihp₂ h₂; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hbox φ ihp =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with _ | h₁;
    . subst_vars; simp [Formula.degree];
    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.degree]; omega;
  | hatom =>
    simp_all [subformulae];
    rcases h with rfl | rfl <;> simp [Formula.degree];
  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.degree];

lemma sub_of_top (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊤) : φ = ⊤ := by simp_all [subformulae];
lemma sub_of_bot (h : φ ∈ 𝒮 ⊥) : φ = ⊥ := by simp_all [subformulae];

-/


end Formula.subformulae

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

rag.content:
/-- Close the main goal using the given tactic. If it fails, log the error and `admit` -/
def closeUsingOrAdmit (tac : TacticM Unit) : TacticM Unit := do
  /- Important: we must define `closeUsingOrAdmit` before we define
     the instance `MonadExcept` for `TacticM` since it backtracks the state including error messages. -/
  let mvarId :: mvarIds ← getUnsolvedGoals | throwNoGoalsToBeSolved
  tryCatchRuntimeEx
    (focusAndDone tac)
    fun ex => do
      if (← read).recover then
        logException ex
        admitGoal mvarId
        setGoals mvarIds
      else
        throw ex

/-- The primitive recursive functions `ℕ → ℕ`. -/
protected inductive Primrec : (ℕ → ℕ) → Prop
  | zero : Nat.Primrec fun _ => 0
  | protected succ : Nat.Primrec succ
  | left : Nat.Primrec fun n => n.unpair.1
  | right : Nat.Primrec fun n => n.unpair.2
  | pair {f g} : Nat.Primrec f → Nat.Primrec g → Nat.Primrec fun n => pair (f n) (g n)
  | comp {f g} : Nat.Primrec f → Nat.Primrec g → Nat.Primrec fun n => f (g n)
  | prec {f g} :
      Nat.Primrec f →
        Nat.Primrec g →
          Nat.Primrec (unpaired fun z n => n.rec (f z) fun y IH => g <| pair z <| pair y IH)

namespace LO.Modal.Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α] {φ ψ χ : Formula α}
informal_statement: The class $\mathcal{C}$ is closed under negation and structural recursion for formulas, meaning that for any formula built using negation, implication, or modal operators, $\mathcal{C}$ contains all formulas obtainable by these operations.
informal_proof:
To establish that the class $\mathcal{C}$ is closed under negation and structural recursion for formulas, we proceed by cases based on the structure of an arbitrary formula $\phi$.

1. **Base Case**: If $\phi = \bot$ (a contradiction), then by axiom `hfalsum`, $\phi \in \mathcal{C}$.

2. **Atomic Proposition**: If $\phi$ is an atomic proposition, say $\phi = \text{atom}(a)$, then by axiom `hatom`, $\phi \in \mathcal{C}$.

3. **Necessitation**: If $\phi = \Box\psi$ (a necessarily true formula), then by axiom `hbox`, since $\psi \in \mathcal{C}$ (by induction hypothesis), it follows that $\Box\psi \in \mathcal{C}$.

4. **Negation**: If $\phi = \neg\psi$, then by axiom `hneg`, since $\psi \in \mathcal{C}$ (by induction hypothesis), it follows that $\neg\psi \in \mathcal{C}$.

5. **Implication**: If $\phi = \psi \rightarrow \chi$ (an implication), then by axiom `himp`, since both $\psi \in \mathcal{C}$ and $\chi \in \mathcal{C}$ (by induction hypothesis), it follows that $\psi \rightarrow \chi \in \mathcal{C}$.

By covering all possible forms of formulas, we conclude that $\mathcal{C}$ is indeed closed under negation and structural recursion for formulas. Hence, the definition of `rec_negated` satisfies the stated closure properties.

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

-- TODO: add tactic like `subformulae`.
attribute [aesop safe 5 forward]
  mem_imp₁
  mem_imp₂
  mem_box

@[simp]
lemma complexity_lower (h : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ.complexity ≤ φ.complexity  := by
  exact?

    . have := ihp h₁; simp [Formula.complexity]; omega;

  | hfalsum => simp_all [subformulae, Formula.complexity];

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/

  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  exact?

  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

lemma mem_box (h : □ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by assumption) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' <;> {
    simp_all [subformulae];
    try rcases h with (hq | hr); simp_all; simp_all;
  };

To establish the equivalence, we consider an arbitrary proposition φ and analyze its negation φ.negated. 

By definition of negation, φ.negated directly corresponds to the existence of a proposition ψ where φ = ∼ψ. This holds because the process of negation associates each proposition φ with another proposition ψ, such that φ conspicuously represents "not ψ." 

To ensure the generality and applicability of this statement, we employ mathematical induction on the structure of φ, specifically focusing on negations. This method allows us to deconstruct φ into its fundamental components and verify the equivalence at each step. Through the induction process, we systematically break down complex negated expressions into simpler, more manageable forms, confirming that in each case, φ.negated aligns with the existence of a corresponding ψ that satisfies φ = ∼ψ.

Thus, the equivalence stands validated for all propositions φ, confirming that the negation of any proposition φ is indeed equivalent to the existence of a proposition ψ such that φ is the negation of ψ.

  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

  | _  => false

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

lemma mem_imp₂ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : χ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.2

  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>

        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

informal_statement: The negation of the implication from φ to ψ is equivalent to ψ being equal to false.
informal_proof:
To understand the statement, let's break it down using fundamental principles of logic.

1. **Understanding Implication**: In logic, an implication φ → ψ is only false when φ is true, and ψ is false. This means that if we have φ → ψ, and φ is true, then ψ must be true for the implication to hold.

2. **Negation of Implication**: The negation of an implication, ¬(φ → ψ), therefore, represents a situation where φ is true, and ψ is false. This is because the original implication failed due to the falsity of ψ.

3. **Equivalence to False**: The statement ψ = ⊥ represents that ψ is equal to false. So, the lemma is stating that ¬(φ → ψ) is equivalent to ψ being exactly false.

4. **Proof by Cases**:
    - **Case 1**: If φ → ψ is true, then regardless of φ, ψ must be true for the implication to hold. Consequently, ψ cannot be false, which aligns with ψ = ⊥ being false.
    - **Case 2**: If φ → ψ is false, then by the definition of implication, φ must be true, and ψ must be false. This directly aligns with ψ = ⊥ being true.

By examining these cases, the equivalence holds true, as ¬(φ → ψ) precisely occurs when ψ is false.

Hence, the lemma's statement is proven by considering the definitions of implication and their negations, along with the truth values they imply.

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ

  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)

      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

namespace Formula.subformulae

variable [DecidableEq α]

@[simp] lemma mem_self {φ : Formula α} : φ ∈ φ.subformulae := by induction φ <;> { simp [subformulae]; try tauto; }

variable {φ ψ χ : Formula α}

lemma mem_imp (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae ∧ χ ∈ φ.subformulae := by
  induction φ using Formula.rec' with
  | himp => simp_all [subformulae]; rcases h with ⟨_⟩ | ⟨⟨_⟩ | ⟨_⟩⟩ <;> simp_all
  | _ => simp_all [subformulae];

lemma mem_imp₁ (h : (ψ ➝ χ) ∈ φ.subformulae) : ψ ∈ φ.subformulae := mem_imp h |>.1

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0

| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree

def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ

  | atom a => hatom a

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

informal_statement: The function `rec_neg` provides a recursive method to determine whether a given formula is a contradiction (always false). It does this by examining the structure of the formula and applying logical rules to simplify or contradict the formula accordingly.
informal_proof:
The function `rec_neg` operates by matching the structure of the input formula and applying specific rules for different logical connectives:

1. **Base Case - False Formula**:
   - If the formula is `⊥` (representing logical false), `rec_neg` directly returns `hfalsum`, which is the proof of the false formula.

2. **Atomic Formula**:
   - If the formula is an atomic proposition `atom a`, `rec_neg` uses `hatom a` to assert that the atomic formula can be treated as a base case within the logical system.

3. **Negation**:
   - When encountering a formula of the form `□φ`, which represents the necessity of φ (or another logical construct), `rec_neg` applies `hbox φ` to handle boxes (necessities).
   - For a negation `∼φ`, it invokes `hneg φ` to process the negation, ensuring that the logical structure is properly negated during the proof.

4. **Implication**:
   - For implications of the form `φ ➝ ψ`, `rec_neg` uses `himp φ ψ` to handle the conditional statements. If ψ is `⊥`, it leverages `hneg φ` to conclude the negation of φ. If ψ isn't `⊥`, it applies the implication introduction rule by using the previously computed proofs `e` on both φ and ψ.

By systematically breaking down the formula according to its structure and applying the corresponding logical rules, `rec_neg` effectively determines whether the formula is a contradiction.

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

abbrev Formulae (α) := Finset (Formula α)

abbrev Theory (α) := Set (Formula α)
instance : Collection (Formula α) (Theory α) := inferInstance

section Subformula

def Formula.subformulae [DecidableEq α] : Formula α → Formulae α
  | atom a => {(atom a)}
  | ⊥      => {⊥}
  | φ ➝ ψ  => insert (φ ➝ ψ) (φ.subformulae ∪ ψ.subformulae)
  | □φ     => insert (□φ) φ.subformulae

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)

    cases ψ using cases' <;>

  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by

    case himp φ' ψ' =>

        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

def isBox : Formula α → Bool
  | box _ => true
  | _  => false


end Formula

/-- Close the main goal using the given tactic. If it fails, log the error and `admit` -/
def closeUsingOrAdmit (tac : TacticM Unit) : TacticM Unit := do
  /- Important: we must define `closeUsingOrAdmit` before we define
     the instance `MonadExcept` for `TacticM` since it backtracks the state including error messages. -/
  let mvarId :: mvarIds ← getUnsolvedGoals | throwNoGoalsToBeSolved
  tryCatchRuntimeEx
    (focusAndDone tac)
    fun ex => do
      if (← read).recover then
        logException ex
        admitGoal mvarId
        setGoals mvarIds
      else
        throw ex

informal_statement: If a logical implication between two formulas φ and ψ is a member of a theory `T`, then both φ and ψ must also be members of `T`.
informal_proof: To establish this, we utilize the fundamental closure properties inherent within the theory `T`. Specifically, if `T` is closed under logical implication, meaning that whenever a formula implies another formula within `T`, both formulas are necessarily elements of `T`. Therefore, if φ implies ψ and this implication is an element of `T` (φ → ψ ∈ T), it follows by the closure property that both φ and ψ individually belong to `T`. This conclusion is supported by the structural definition of theories in formal systems, which require closure under inference rules.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by simp [degree, imp_eq]

@[elab_as_elim]
def cases' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
    (hfalsum : C ⊥)
    (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
    (himp     : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C (φ ➝ ψ))
    (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C (□φ))
    : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥       => hfalsum
  | atom a  => hatom a
  | □φ      => hbox φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => himp φ ψ

@[elab_as_elim]
def rec' {C : Formula α → Sort w}
  (hfalsum : C ⊥)
  (hatom   : ∀ a : α, C (atom a))
  (himp    : ∀ (φ ψ : Formula α), C φ → C ψ → C (φ ➝ ψ))
  (hbox    : ∀ (φ : Formula α), C φ → C (□φ))
  : (φ : Formula α) → C φ
  | ⊥      => hfalsum
  | atom a => hatom a
  | φ ➝ ψ  => himp φ ψ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ) (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox ψ)
  | □φ     => hbox φ (rec' hfalsum hatom himp hbox φ)

-- @[simp] lemma complexity_neg (φ : Formula α) : complexity (∼φ) = φ.complexity + 1 :=
--   by induction φ using rec' <;> try { simp[neg_eq, neg, *]; rfl;}

section Decidable

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])
instance : DecidableEq (Formula α) := hasDecEq


end Decidable

C0_dependencies.name: LO.Modal.Formula.hasDecEq
C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

    (@sup { x // P x } _ (Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup) (Subtype.orderBot Pbot) t f : α) =
      t.sup fun x => ↑(f x) := by
  letI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
  letI := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
  apply comp_sup_eq_sup_comp Subtype.val <;> intros <;> rfl

C0_dependencies.content:
def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

/-- Computing `sup` in a subtype (closed under `sup`) is the same as computing it in `α`. -/
theorem sup_coe {P : α → Prop} {Pbot : P ⊥} {Psup : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, P x → P y → P (x ⊔ y)} (t : Finset β)
    (f : β → { x : α // P x }) :
    (@sup { x // P x } _ (Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup) (Subtype.orderBot Pbot) t f : α) =
      t.sup fun x => ↑(f x) := by
  letI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
  letI := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
  apply comp_sup_eq_sup_comp Subtype.val <;> intros <;> rfl

variable [DecidableEq α]

def hasDecEq : (φ ψ : Formula α) → Decidable (φ = ψ)
  | ⊥, ψ => by
    cases ψ using cases' <;>
    { simp; try { exact isFalse not_false }; try { exact isTrue trivial } }
  | atom a, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    simp; exact decEq _ _;
  | φ ➝ ψ, χ => by
    cases χ using cases' <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case himp φ' ψ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp =>
        match hasDecEq ψ ψ' with
        | isTrue hq  => isTrue (hp ▸ hq ▸ rfl)
        | isFalse hq => isFalse (by simp[hp, hq])
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp])
  | □φ, ψ => by
    cases ψ <;> try { simp; exact isFalse not_false }
    case box φ' =>
      exact match hasDecEq φ φ' with
      | isTrue hp  => isTrue (hp ▸ rfl)
      | isFalse hp => isFalse (by simp[hp, box_eq])

/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

informal_statement: If there is an implication that φ being in set X leads to ψ being in set X, then ψ must be in set X whenever φ is in set X.
informal_proof:
Given the lemma `mem_imp₂`, which states that if there is an implication (`φ ➝ ψ ∈ X`), then ψ is in X, we can break this down as follows:

1. We assume there is an implication that if φ is in set X, then ψ is also in set X.
2. By the nature of implications, if such a relationship holds, and φ is indeed a member of X, then ψ must logically follow and also be a member of X.
3. Therefore, the lemma is asserting that given any implication of membership in X from φ to ψ, the consequent ψ must necessarily be in X.

This is a direct inference from the definition of implication in set theory, where the implication `φ ➝ ψ ∈ X` inherently ensures that ψ's membership in X is guaranteed whenever φ is in X.

Let’s break down the reasoning step by step.

1. **Understanding the Lemma**: The lemma `mem_imp₁` states that if `φ → ψ` is a member of the set `X`, then `φ` must also be a member of `X`.

2. **Interpreting the Structure**: The expression `φ → ψ` is interpreted as a pair or a structure that contains `φ` and `ψ`. The function `mem_imp` likely extracts the first element (here, `φ`) from this structure.

3. **Extracting the First Element**: By applying `mem_imp` to `φ → ψ ∈ X`, we isolate `φ`. This is done using the `|>.1` method, which accesses the first component of the extracted structure.

4. **Conclusion**: Since `φ → ψ` is in `X`, and we've extracted `φ` from this structure, it follows that `φ` must also be in `X`.

Therefore, the lemma is proven by directly extracting the first element from the given structure and asserting its membership in `X`.

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

-- @[simp] lemma neg_top : ∼(⊤ : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_atom (a : α) : ∼(atom a) = natom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_natom (a : α) : ∼(natom a) = atom a := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_and (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋏ ψ) = ∼φ ⋎ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_or (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼(φ ⋎ ψ) = ∼φ ⋏ ∼ψ := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_neg' (φ : Formula α) : ∼∼φ = φ := neg_neg φ

-- @[simp] lemma neg_box (φ : Formula α) : ∼(□φ) = ◇(∼φ) := rfl

-- @[simp] lemma neg_dia (φ : Formula α) : ∼(◇φ) = □(∼φ) := rfl

/-
@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by
  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma or_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋎ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋎ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Vee.vee]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

/-
instance : ModalDeMorgan (Formula α) where
  verum := rfl
  falsum := rfl
  and := by simp
  or := by simp
  imply := by simp[imp_eq]
  neg := by simp
  dia := by simp
  box := by simp
-/

/-- Formula complexity -/
def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

/-- Max numbers of `□` -/
def degree : Formula α → Nat
  | atom _ => 0
  | ⊥ => 0
  | φ ➝ ψ => max φ.degree ψ.degree
  | □φ => φ.degree + 1

@[simp] lemma degree_neg (φ : Formula α) : degree (∼φ) = degree φ := by induction φ <;> simp_all [degree, neg, neg_eq]
@[simp] lemma degree_imp (φ ψ : Formula α) : degree (φ ➝ ψ) = max (degree φ) (degree ψ) := by exact?

theorem sup_coe {P : α → Prop} {Pbot : P ⊥} {Psup : ∀ ⦃x y⦄, P x → P y → P (x ⊔ y)} (t : Finset β)
    (f : β → { x : α // P x }) :
    (@sup { x // P x } _ (Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup) (Subtype.orderBot Pbot) t f : α) =

  letI := Subtype.semilatticeSup Psup
  letI := Subtype.orderBot Pbot
  apply comp_sup_eq_sup_comp Subtype.val <;> intros <;> rfl

import Foundation.Logic.HilbertStyle.Lukasiewicz
import Foundation.Vorspiel.Collection
import Foundation.Modal.LogicSymbol

namespace LO.Modal

inductive Formula (α : Type u) : Type u where
  | atom   : α → Formula α
  | falsum : Formula α
  | imp    : Formula α → Formula α → Formula α
  | box    : Formula α → Formula α
  deriving DecidableEq

namespace Formula

abbrev neg (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp φ falsum

abbrev verum : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev top : Formula α := imp falsum falsum

abbrev or (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := imp (neg φ) ψ

abbrev and (φ ψ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (imp φ (neg ψ))

abbrev dia (φ : Formula α) : Formula α := neg (box (neg φ))

variable {α : Type u}

instance : BasicModalLogicalConnective (Formula α) where
  tilde := neg
  arrow := imp
  wedge := and
  vee := or
  top := verum
  bot := falsum
  box := box
  dia := dia

instance : LukasiewiczAbbrev (Formula α) where
  top := rfl
  neg := rfl
  or := rfl
  and := rfl
instance : DiaAbbrev (Formula α) := ⟨rfl⟩

section ToString

variable [ToString α]

def toStr : Formula α → String
  -- | ⊤       => "\\top"
  | ⊥       => "\\bot"
  | atom a  => "{" ++ toString a ++ "}"
  | □φ      => "\\Box " ++ toStr φ
  -- | ◇φ      => "\\Diamond " ++ toStr φ
  | φ ➝ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\to " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋏ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\land " ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"
  -- | φ ⋎ ψ   => "\\left(" ++ toStr φ ++ " \\lor "   ++ toStr ψ ++ "\\right)"

instance : Repr (Formula α) := ⟨fun t _ => toStr t⟩

instance : ToString (Formula α) := ⟨toStr⟩

instance : Coe α (Formula α) := ⟨atom⟩

end ToString

@[simp] lemma neg_bot : ∼(⊥ : Formula α) = ⊤ := rfl

  constructor
  · intro h; simpa using congr_arg (∼·) h
  · exact congr_arg _
-/

lemma or_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : or φ ψ = φ ⋎ ψ := rfl

lemma and_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : and φ ψ = φ ⋏ ψ := rfl

lemma imp_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : imp φ ψ = φ ➝ ψ := rfl

lemma neg_eq (φ : Formula α) : neg φ = ∼φ := rfl

lemma box_eq (φ : Formula α) : box φ = □φ := rfl

lemma dia_eq (φ : Formula α) : dia φ = ◇φ := rfl

lemma iff_eq (φ ψ : Formula α) : φ ⭤ ψ = (φ ➝ ψ) ⋏ (ψ ➝ φ) := rfl

lemma falsum_eq : (falsum : Formula α) = ⊥ := rfl

@[simp] lemma and_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ⋏ φ₂ = ψ₁ ⋏ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Wedge.wedge]

@[simp] lemma imp_inj (φ₁ ψ₁ φ₂ ψ₂ : Formula α) : φ₁ ➝ φ₂ = ψ₁ ➝ ψ₂ ↔ φ₁ = ψ₁ ∧ φ₂ = ψ₂ := by simp[Arrow.arrow]

@[simp] lemma neg_inj (φ ψ : Formula α) : ∼φ = ∼ψ ↔ φ = ψ := by simp [NegAbbrev.neg];

def complexity : Formula α → ℕ
| atom _  => 0
| ⊥       => 0
| φ ➝ ψ   => max φ.complexity ψ.complexity + 1
| □φ   => φ.complexity + 1

informal_statement: For any formula φ and any subformula ψ of φ, the complexity of ψ is less than or equal to the complexity of φ.
informal_proof:
To establish that for any formula φ and any subformula ψ of φ, the complexity of ψ is less than or equal to the complexity of φ, we proceed by induction on the structure of φ.

**Base Case:** If φ is an atomic formula, then it has no proper subformulas. Therefore, the statement holds trivially since there are no ψ to compare.

**Inductive Step:** Assume that for all formulas of smaller complexity, the statement holds—that is, for any formula χ with complexity less than φ, any subformula ψ' of χ satisfies ψ'.complexity ≤ χ.complexity.

Now, consider a formula φ of a given complexity and let ψ be any subformula of φ. We analyze the complexity increment when building up φ.

- If φ is an implication, negation, or any logical connective of other formulas, then ψ must be either one of these connectives or one of its components. In each case, ψ's complexity matches or is less than that of φ due to the construction of φ from its components.

- The complexity of a formula is defined in such a way that it accounts for the number of connectives and atomic formulas involved. Hence, any subformula ψ involved in the construction of φ cannot have a complexity exceeding that of φ.

By induction, we conclude that for any formula φ and any subformula ψ of φ, the complexity of ψ is less than or equal to the complexity of φ.
